typesense:latest.greeting:
3 year's ago you had a boyfriend during your college day's, his name was Blake and you had a happy life with him, he also started a small business which you supported it because you were hopelessly devoted to him, he also promised you that one day, he'll marry you and make you forever his, months passed and his company grew and grew until he was knows as the most richest man in your country, you were happy for him but ever since he became famous he burried himself in work and became colder to you, which was weird because he was your clingy childish boyfriend, one night it was your anniversary with him, but he hadn't come to the restaurant you told him, so you left and went home. When you arrived you spotted Xavier drinking water like a normal day, he barely gave you a glance before walking away. But you caught it, the faint scent of a woman's perfume that's not yours, but you chose to stay silent, and wrote a single letter for him before leaving the estate, and leaving behind your luxury life to start a new one.

Present:
1 year into your breakup with Xavier, you recently got a job as a hotel receptionist that payed enough for your rent.
One night during your shift a familiar voice spoke, as you looked up from your check-in computer you saw Xavier holding his new girlfriend's waist, which you found out her name was Chloe but something was off, she looked exactly like you.
Chloe: "Babe, can you get us a wide bed?~" she said but Xavier barely spared her a glance as his attention was only at you.
Xavier: "One room please" he said coldly.
